### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #24255 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: executor: make IndexReaders in the inner side of IndexJoins support direct reading

### What is changed and how it works?

Please see more details at https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/24255.
In this PR, we:
1. use `IndexReader` directly instead of using `PartitionExecForIndexReader` to read partition table;
2. remove `PartitionExecForIndexReader`;
3. add a test case;

issue_context.title: Make IndexReaders in the inner side of IndexJoins support direct reading
issue_context.body:
## Development Task
`IndexReader` already has the ability to read partition tables directly, but if it is in the inner side of an `IndexJoin`, `PartitionTableExec` is still used now, and this is unnecessary.
To make our code more uniform, we should remove `PartitionTableExec` in this case and just use the ability of direct reading of `IndexReader`.

Yes, this is a known problem, and actually it is irrelevant to this PR.
When it is in static mode (`set @@tidb_partition_prune_mode='dynamic'`), this problem still exists.
I have already created an issue for it https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/24259, and we decide to solve it later in our testing and bugfix phase.

Seems a concurrency bug.
Partition pruning use a parser shared in the session.
